response.sql:
WITH customer_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    COUNT(*) / (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) FROM Orders) as share
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
  customer_id,
  order_count,
  share
FROM customer_shares
WHERE share >= (
  SELECT MIN(share) FROM (
    SELECT share FROM customer_shares
    ORDER BY share DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t
)
ORDER BY share DESC, (share IS NULL) ASC

assumptions.assumption: "For each customer in the orders table" means customers who have placed at least one order (customers appearing in the Orders table), not all customers in the Customers table.
